verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is an API-driven regulated bank, so issuing virtual or sub-account numbers is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents programmatically issuing unique account or branch/routing numbers, virtual accounts, or per-customer collection accounts. Organizations managing multiple Workspaces, payment splits, Boleto/Pix charges, and "automated reconciliation" marketing are adjacent features and do not show account-number provisioning at scale.
